Mickey Mouse.name: Mickey Mouse
Mickey Mouse.summary: Mickey Mouse (Mickey Mouse II in Japan) is the third game in the Crazy Castle series, and the second starring Mickey Mouse. It was later released in North America as Bugs Bunny Crazy Castle 2 and in Europe as Hugo and Mickey Mouse.

Monopoly.name: Monopoly
Monopoly.summary: The Game Boy port of Monopoly.

Super Mario 4.name: Super Mario 4
Super Mario 4.summary: Super Mario 4 is a hack of the Game Boy game Crayon Shin Chan 4, originally by Bandai. It is a very common title on multicarts.

Turok - Battle of the Bionosaurs.name: Turok: Battle of the Bionosaurs
Turok - Battle of the Bionosaurs.summary: Turok: Battle of the Bionosaurs is an action platformer Game Boy adaptation of Turok: Dinosaur Hunter, developed by Bit Managers and published by Acclaim.
